text:
sophia: quick check  prototype link: https://www.figma.com/file/latency-compact-badges. Main issues: live updates during drag vs commit on release, sampled-region visual, and mini-legend contrast.
jamal: pointer drag -> live (debounced 250ms). keyboard -> commit on Enter/Escape. keep container dimensions fixed so numbers swap without shifting.
ara: a11y: avoid spamming screen readers. use aria-live="polite" and only announce final value when possible. current mini-legend color (~#666) fails AA; bump to #2f3a44 or increase weight.
tal: copy: change "Sampling 1/10" to "Sampling: 10%". CTA in top-right looks like a primary button but is a link; either change semantics or visual weight. p95 tooltip copy -> "p95 latency".
sophia: proposal: show compact numeric badges during drag, expand on release. sampled overlay: subtle diagonal hatch (12px spacing, 35% opacity). add toggle "Show sampled overlay" in legend. presets should hint, not auto-snap; power users can enable snapping in settings.
jamal: perf note: make scrubber overlay composited, throttle analytics, only repaint numbers. I'll prototype debounce + keyboard commit.
design-bot: automated check: .mini-legend .label contrast fail. recommend #2f3a44 or font-weight 600.
ara: also add non-visual indication: when sampling on, show text badge "sampled" so keyboard/screen-reader users know.
sophia: will update figma and file tickets: DESIGN-4991 (contrast + badges), DESIGN-4992 (scrubber commit behavior), DESIGN-4993 (sampled overlay + toggle).
